steps.content: You get closer and closer to the alley, and can faintly hear Mad Shears in the fog.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: ...I picked it up here... This must be the place... The other one must be here, too...
You quickly slip into the fog to hide. The residents who have been robbed of their worries are in a daze, while Mad Shears is still mumbling to itself.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: Can't cut it off... So much hair... Hair's so long... Stop growing, stop growing... I can't cut it off...

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: ...Why... Where are my shears... Where is it?!
Mad Shears looms at the end of the alley, frantically cutting its own hair, repeating the same things over and over again.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: Where are my shears?! Where are the shears that can chop off all this hair?!!
The severed hairs fall to the ground, turning into hideous monsters.
...It looks past the monsters and spots you.
You dodge Mad Shears' sudden attack, but the hair monsters it created block your path. But now...
You flaunt your faint red mark. Its power is still quite weak, but judging from its fearsome performance last night, it can still scare off others.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: How did you become so weak? Weren't you so powerful that night? The shears you're obsessed with don't like you anymore?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: How about giving them to me? Someone once said I'm a lot stronger than you.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: You? Stronger than me? Ahhhhh shut up!! I've nothing to envy, nothing at all!!! Shut your mouth!!!!
Its hair grows rapidly again, and attacks you.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: Go away! Be gone from my world!! I don't want to see you again!!
